sub_graphs.name: Trie Data Structures
sub_graphs.description: Core data structures for the Merkle Patricia Trie: LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode, and the generic Trie container. Defines the node type union and type variables for key/value parameterization.

invariants.text: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT equals keccak256(RLP(b'')) = 0x56e81f171bcc55a6ff8345e692c0f86e5b48e01b996cadc001622fb5e363b421.
InternalNode is a union type: LeafNode | ExtensionNode | BranchNode. No other node types are valid.
BranchNode.subnodes must always be a tuple of exactly 16 Extended elements (BranchSubnodes).
Node type union covers Account | Bytes | LegacyTransaction | Receipt | Uint | U256 | Withdrawal | None.

data_structures.name: LeafNode
data_structures.description: Leaf node in the Merkle Trie. Stores the remaining key suffix and the associated value.

data_structures.name: ExtensionNode
data_structures.description: Extension node in the Merkle Trie. Compresses shared key prefixes into a single node.

data_structures.name: BranchNode
data_structures.description: Branch node in the Merkle Trie. Contains 16 subnodes (one per nibble) and an optional value.

data_structures.name: Trie
data_structures.description: The Merkle Trie container. Generic over key type K (bound to Bytes) and value type V. 'secured' flag indicates if keys are hashed before insertion.

state_variables.name: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT
state_variables.description: Constant root hash of an empty trie: keccak256(RLP(b'')).

sub_graphs.name: Trie CRUD Operations
sub_graphs.description: Core read/write operations on the Trie: trie_set, trie_get, and copy_trie. These form the public API for manipulating trie contents.

invariants.text: trie_set with value == trie.default removes the key from _data (default values are represented by absence in the trie).
trie_get returns trie.default for any key not present in _data.
For any key k and value v != trie.default: trie_set(trie, k, v) followed by trie_get(trie, k) returns v.
copy_trie produces a shallow copy: modifications to the copy's _data dict do not affect the original (but frozen stored objects are shared).

functions.signature: trie_set(trie: Trie[K, V], key: K, value: V) -> None
functions.description: Stores an item in the trie. Deletes the key if value equals trie.default.
preconditions: trie is a valid Trie instance
postconditions: If value == trie.default: key is removed from trie._data
If value != trie.default: trie._data[key] == value

functions.signature: trie_get(trie: Trie[K, V], key: K) -> V
functions.description: Gets an item from the trie. Returns trie.default if key is missing.
preconditions: trie is a valid Trie instance
postconditions: Returns trie._data[key] if key in trie._data, else trie.default

functions.description: Creates a shallow copy of the trie. Frozen stored objects are reused by reference.
preconditions: trie is a valid Trie instance
postconditions: Returns a new Trie with same secured flag, default, and a shallow copy of _data

sub_graphs.name: Node Encoding
sub_graphs.description: Encoding functions that transform trie nodes into their RLP-serialized form for hashing. Includes encode_internal_node for internal MPT nodes and encode_node for typed value nodes.

invariants.text: encode_internal_node(None) returns the RLP encoding of b'' (empty bytes).
If RLP-encoded node is < 32 bytes, encode_internal_node returns the unencoded (raw) form; otherwise it returns keccak256 of the encoded form.
encode_node for Account type requires a non-None storage_root parameter.
encode_node delegates to previous_trie.encode_node for unrecognized node types (fallback to Prague fork).

functions.description: Encodes a Merkle Trie node into RLP form. Returns raw form if encoded < 32 bytes, else keccak256 hash.
preconditions: node is None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode
postconditions: If node is None: result is RLP-encodable as b''
If encoded size < 32: returns unencoded tuple/list
If encoded size >= 32: returns keccak256(encoded)

functions.signature: encode_node(node: Node, storage_root: Optional[Bytes] = None) -> Bytes
functions.description: Encode a typed Node for storage in the Merkle Trie. Dispatches based on node type.
preconditions: If node is Account, storage_root must not be None
postconditions: Returns RLP-encoded bytes representation of the node

sub_graphs.name: Nibble Encoding
sub_graphs.description: Nibble-level encoding utilities for the Hex-Prefix (HP) encoding used in Merkle Patricia Tries. Converts between byte arrays and nibble lists, and compresses nibble lists into compact form with leaf/extension flags.

invariants.text: nibble_list_to_compact encodes the is_leaf flag in bit 1 of the high nibble of the first byte.
nibble_list_to_compact encodes parity (odd/even length) in bit 0 of the high nibble of the first byte.
bytes_to_nibble_list always produces output of exactly 2 * len(input) bytes, each in range [0, 15].
nibble_list_to_compact and bytes_to_nibble_list are used as a pair: bytes -> nibbles for key processing, nibbles -> compact for storage.

functions.description: Compresses a nibble-list into a standard byte array with HP encoding flags for leaf/extension distinction and parity.
preconditions: All elements of x are in range [0, 15]
postconditions: First byte encodes is_leaf flag and parity of nibble count
Remaining bytes pack two nibbles each

functions.description: Converts a byte array to a nibble list (each byte split into two nibbles).
preconditions: bytes_ is a valid Bytes instance
postconditions: Output length is 2 * len(bytes_)
Each output byte is in [0, 15]

sub_graphs.name: Root Computation and Patricialize
sub_graphs.description: Core Merkle Patricia Trie root computation. Prepares the trie data, recursively patricializes the key-value mapping into a tree of internal nodes, and computes the final root hash.

invariants.text: root() of an empty trie (no entries in _data) returns EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT via encode_internal_node(None) -> keccak256(RLP(b'')).
_prepare_trie hashes keys with keccak256 when trie.secured is True (secure trie mode).
_prepare_trie raises AssertionError if any encoded value is b'' (empty encoded values are invalid).
patricialize returns None for empty mappings, LeafNode for single-entry mappings, ExtensionNode when all keys share a common prefix at the current level, and BranchNode otherwise.
In patricialize, Account, Receipt, and Uint values must not appear at branch-level internal nodes (only at leaf nodes).
The root hash is deterministic: the same set of key-value pairs always produces the same root regardless of insertion order.

functions.signature: _prepare_trie(trie: Trie[K, V], get_storage_root: Optional[Callable[[Address], Root]] = None) -> Mapping[Bytes, Bytes]
functions.description: Prepares trie for root calculation by encoding all values, optionally hashing keys (secured mode), and converting keys to nibble-list format.
preconditions: If trie contains Account values, get_storage_root must not be None
All encoded values must be non-empty
postconditions: Returns mapping of nibble-encoded keys to RLP-encoded values
If trie.secured: keys are keccak256(original_key) converted to nibbles
If not trie.secured: keys are original keys converted to nibbles

functions.signature: root(trie: Trie[K, V], get_storage_root: Optional[Callable[[Address], Root]] = None) -> Root
functions.description: Computes the Merkle Patricia Trie root hash. Prepares trie data, patricializes into node tree, encodes root node, and returns final hash.
preconditions: trie is a valid Trie instance
If trie contains Account values, get_storage_root must be provided
postconditions: Returns a 32-byte Root hash
If encoded root < 32 bytes: returns keccak256 of RLP encoding
If encoded root >= 32 bytes: returns the hash directly as Root

functions.signature: patricialize(obj: Mapping[Bytes, Bytes], level: Uint) -> Optional[InternalNode]
functions.description: Recursively builds the Merkle Patricia Trie structure from a flat key-value mapping. Chooses between LeafNode, ExtensionNode, and BranchNode based on key structure at each level.
preconditions: Keys in obj are in nibble-list format
level indicates current depth in the nibble key space
postconditions: Returns None if obj is empty
Returns LeafNode if obj has exactly one entry
Returns ExtensionNode if all keys share a common prefix at current level
Returns BranchNode with 16 subnodes otherwise

functions.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix between two sequences.
preconditions: a and b are valid sequences
postconditions: Returns int in range [0, min(len(a), len(b))]
a[:result] == b[:result]
